defer_not_now.title: Do not add momentum overlay to base value screen

defer_not_now.revisit_when: Explicit product decision after walk-forward evidence that a momentum grace rule beats trailing stops and screen-only exits on cost-adjusted excess return

defer_not_now.title: Do not route automated paper-auto or decision-review through LLMs
defer_not_now.summary: Learning loop knobs (decision-review, future L85 grace auto-tune) must stay rule-based on structured JSON marks. Pro+ model access is for human/agent synthesis and selective research only — not live paper trading decisions.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: Never for live automation; only reconsider if building a separate experimental LLM paper track with its own control datum

defer_not_now.title: Keep exit-shadow cohort observe-only until maturity

defer_not_now.title: Do not nudge decision-review portfolio knobs below history floor
defer_not_now.summary: Automated decision-review knob steps (max positions, timing strictness, conviction floor, sector cap) should not fire until the target track has ≥4 weekly marks and ≥2 closed trades. Below that floor, accumulate data hands-off.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: Each paper track (ai_judgment, rules, momentum_grace) crosses the floor independently; then enable per-track knob review in decision-review

defer_not_now.title: Gate AI judgment on confidence or memo_quality thresholds
defer_not_now.summary: Tempting to filter accumulate names by research_confidence or memo_quality, but that is a live paper knob before observe-only counterfactuals exist; keep verdict/adjusted_signal gating until evidence.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: After observe-only counterfactuals show confidence/memo_quality predict adverse outcomes

defer_not_now.summary: Do not move weekly memo usefulness synthesis (gap-fill rollups, per-ticker open-question triage, research_model_suggestions eng compile) into the monthly horizon agent. Horizon may still strategically ask whether memo schema should better aid AI judgment (see L141); implementation stays in the research/post_run loop.

defer_not_now.revisit_when: If further secret exposure incidents occur or Pages no longer needs a public repo

defer_not_now.summary: Do not reverse-engineer a full new screen/model from Suite A after-cost returns — those P&Ls are stress-distorted and history is thin. Suite B should warm-start from current AI+rules books and transplant stress-surviving knobs (conviction, exit confirms, cooldowns) as priors only.

defer_not_now.revisit_when: Suite B AI+rules endurance is trusted and human triage load is light

defer_not_now.title: Do not treat Suite A conviction floors as Suite B policy
defer_not_now.summary: High min_conviction discovered under 3% stress is a churn-survival filter for relative AI-vs-rules assessment. With fair costs, the same floor can starve deployable edge. Keep A floors on A; let B run suite-local conviction (including easing) and only promote floors that still help after fair costs.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: Someone proposes copying ai_judgment min_conviction onto ai_judgment_fair as a permanent lock, or using A epoch success alone to claim deployable conviction policy

defer_not_now.title: Live sentiment scoring from mined news phrases
defer_not_now.summary: Do not wire bag-of-words or lexicon sentiment into screen weights or paper knobs. Open-source news + phrase mining may later inform research memos or event tags; treating it as a quant model remains premature (extends N6).
defer_not_now.revisit_when: Phrase-trajectory panel shows out-of-sample lift on trajectory flips, and analysis-review proposes a gated experiment

defer_not_now.title: Do not add level-crossings as a screening model input
defer_not_now.summary: First-touch stop/target/SMA crosses are subsequent path after a buy-tier signal. Feeding them into Graham/quality/GARP/risk pass-fail would mix execution outcomes into point-in-time value identity and leak post-recommendation price action.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: Only if a dedicated technical/timing family is designed with strict point-in-time features (RSI/SMA at screen date), not path-after-signal crossings.

defer_not_now.title: Do not retune knobs from the first chart-outcome mix
defer_not_now.summary: The first human and deterministic read of buy-tier charts is mixed_no_terrible (0 stop hits, 0 terrible paths). That is not a reason to tighten stops, widen targets, or apply decision-review knobs.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: chart_outcome_review verdict becomes has_terrible, or stop_hit is above 0 on two consecutive Sunday passes

defer_not_now.title: Do not start entry-timing experiments from this mixed chart pass
defer_not_now.summary: The first chart-outcome read is mixed_no_terrible with short-term underwater tolerated while hypotheses stand. That is not a cue to add wait filters or delay buys. The live test is longer-horizon pick success on the paper book.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: buy-tier chart outcomes span several months and drop-to-recovery or paper hold-recovery can show whether early underwater names recovered

defer_not_now.title: Open non-FTSE markets from the status grid into the live screener
defer_not_now.summary: Do not wire market-status tiles into the live FTSE 350 screener or publish path. Keep richness before breadth: library markets stay offline until stage 4.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: Project stage 4: a shard has cleared Phase 3 and FTSE primary AI-judgment shows persistent excess.

defer_not_now.title: Execute dollar-cost averaging on live paper books
defer_not_now.summary: Do not change paper-auto fills to actual multi-tranche DCA until the model-independent overlay has enough closed episodes to rank cadences and a human acks ready_for_cadence_analysis.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: learning_tracks_entry_dca readiness.ready_for_cadence_analysis is true and a leading cadence is stable across >=2 tracks

defer_not_now.title: Lot-link DCA entry blocks to tactical sells
defer_not_now.summary: Do not pair individual DCA tranches with tactical take-profits to 'average down' remaining cost. Paper avg_cost is weighted-average (a skim realizes P&L, it does not lower remaining basis). A sell+rebuy clip must clear Suite A 6% round-trip or fair UK ~0.55% including stamp. Net end-value after costs is the only promotion metric; if anything is scored later, it is pause-or-cheaper-only remaining adds after a harvest during build (catalog factor skim_linked_remaining_adds).
defer_not_now.revisit_when: entry_dca_overlay ready_for_cadence_analysis AND graduated harvest skims occur during open starter/build windows AND fair-cost Suite B is the evaluation lens

defer_not_now.title: Pyramid add-on while still held beyond original sleeve
defer_not_now.summary: A second buy trigger on a name still at/near full sleeve (pyramiding) is a different decision from recommit-after-exit. Do not allow adds above the original target until first-entry cadence is ranked and conviction-weighted sizing exists. Observe recommit-after-exit separately so it does not contaminate DCA evidence.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: entry_dca_overlay ready_for_cadence_analysis on first_entry AND conviction_weighted_sizing is active

defer_not_now.summary: Live inventory is 1 open task / 4 shadows against the generous 12/8 soft budget. Raising the cap further would not add coverage (lifecycle stages are already perpetual) and would weaken the agent-triage signal. Keep 12/8 until Sunday open tasks repeatedly hit the 75% warn.
defer_not_now.revisit_when: experiment_inventory.complexity.warn_discretionary_tasks is true on 3 consecutive Sunday director runs

defer_not_now.title: Do not lift shard capacity just because GHA minutes are free
